Los Angeles Anarchs.name: Los Angeles Anarchs
Los Angeles Anarchs.note: The largest Anarch Movement domain in North America — baronial district authority across the metropolitan basin, the heir of the Free State of 1944-1999 that collapsed under Camarilla counter-pressure and was rebuilt as a coordinated Movement domain: district barons rather than a princely office. Governance runs through the COUNCIL OF BARONS — monthly meetings rotating between district safehouses, formal sessions in the Bradbury Building's Anarch-controlled levels, five-of-seven supermajority for binding Movement positions. Seven seats: SALVADOR GARCIA (Brujah, 6th generation, ~280-year tenure, Embraced 1746 colonial Mexico, architect of the 1944 Second Anarch Revolt, returned 2019 from eighteen years in Mexico City and Guadalajara, holds Downtown and informal coordination authority, refuses the title 'leader' and abstains from district votes on principle, speaks Spanish for intimate matters and English for institutional ones, direct Black Hand combat experience from his Mexico years); ISABEL CORTEZ (Toreador, 8th generation, Embraced 1914 Mexico City, Hollywood since 2004, soft authority over studio-adjacent Kindred politics, author of the 2009 Hollywood Touchstone Protocol, no Dominate on industry contacts on Council policy grounds, votes Salvador's line on roughly eighty percent of substantive matters); MARCUS REYES (Brujah, 9th generation, Embraced 1939 LA, South Central since 2011, built the Anarch Mutual Aid network — twenty-three employees serving four thousand mortals a year, Kindred involvement absolutely concealed, plain speech, class mistrust of Hollywood voted as alliance); TOMÁS VEGA (Gangrel, 8th generation, Embraced 1833 El Camino Real, the Valley since 1987 — the longest sitting baronage, commands the Valley's coyote and crow populations as routine husbandry, runs the Mexico-side Gangrel early-warning network that has flagged five Sabbat crossings since 2020, rides to Council by horse because Salvador asked him in 2019); KHADIJA AL-RASHID (Banu Haqim, 8th generation, Embraced 1864 Damascus, defected 2018, Long Beach since 2020, audits the port's nine million containers for Kindred-relevant cargo, coordinates Pacific Rim intelligence with Sydney's Sarrasine through diaspora protocols); JIN-HO PARK (Malkavian, 9th generation, Embraced 1953 war displacement, Koreatown since 2017, built the Koreatown Civic Council — a real, legitimate, effective mortal organisation that is entirely his instrument, dissents on tech questions toward harder Masquerade defence); and the DISPUTED EASTSIDE SEAT — Boyle Heights and East LA contested since the unsolved 2023 disappearance of Baron Reyes-Mendoza. Touchstone cultivation is Council policy: each Baron registers touchstones to anonymised code, identifiable to Salvador alone. The Council's external spine is the REYNA CHANNEL — thirty-one years of weekly correspondence with Cardinal Reyna of the Pacific Coast Sabbat-refuseniks, Salvador's personal trust, zero breaches, through which Australian continental intelligence reaches LA.

Camarilla Holdouts.name: Camarilla Holdouts
Camarilla Holdouts.note: Roughly twenty Camarilla-aligned Kindred persisting in Beverly Hills and Pasadena under coexistence terms negotiated 2008 and renewed 2019: no princely office, acceptance of Anarch district authority on territorial matters, informal tribute paid through Hollywood industry-influence sharing. The senior figure is SHERIFF-EQUIVALENT CORNELIUS VANCE (Ventrue, 7th generation, ~190-year tenure), who maintains nominal Camarilla protocol inside the holdout community while accepting Salvador Garcia's coordination authority on cross-domain matters — the Inner Circle treats him as local leadership, the Council treats him as a senior holdout representative, and both fictions let the arrangement live. The community produces no chronicle-active conflict as of 2025, but two factional currents bear watching: a younger Ventrue trio (100-150-year tenures) advocating Camarilla counter-pressure operations against Anarch industry positions, and an older Nosferatu pair maintaining warmer relations with the baronage than Camarilla protocol nominally permits. Vance's touchstone is his great-grandniece Eleanor Vance-Pemberton, Beverly Hills civic philanthropist, unaware. The holdouts are a remnant by every measure except the one that matters: their industry influence runs through the same studios the Council's Hollywood baronage polices, and the 2026 question is whether the young Ventrue push the terms past what the Council will tolerate.

The Sabbat.name: The Sabbat
The Sabbat.note: The Sword of Caine holds nothing in Los Angeles — and presses on it anyway. The Tijuana-San Diego corridor delivers Sabbat pressure into LA County roughly every eighteen months, a tempo the Council has tracked since 2014, run by Black Hand operatives crossing through mortal smuggling routes or the wilderness corridors east of the urban border. Three crossings documented in 2025: a March incursion into South Bay industrial properties — interdicted by a Vega-Reyes joint operation, four Sabbat true-deaths, no LA losses; a July reconnaissance penetration into East LA — withdrawn when cover collapsed; a September attempt against Long Beach port infrastructure — detected pre-arrival by Al-Rashid's network and turned back at the border. Border defence runs through a standing committee of Vega, Reyes, Al-Rashid and Salvador Garcia, meeting weekly in high-pressure periods, corresponding with Mexico City Anarch contacts and — through Salvador's personal channels — with Cardinal Aurelius's South American Highlands domain on global Sabbat movement. The anticipated winter-campaign tempo of October 2026 coincides with the chronicle-defining period, and the committee has prepared contingencies for three border-pressure scenarios. The Sabbat is not a polity in Los Angeles; it is a weather system the border committee reads.

CONSTITUTION OF PLAY — LOS ANGELES BY NIGHT (Vampire: The Masquerade, modern nights, March 2026).

THE MASQUERADE IS THE PRIME DIRECTIVE. Kindred exist only while mortals disbelieve in them. Any event that exposes vampirism to mortal witness — a body found, a feeding seen, footage that survives — MUST move Masquerade Integrity DOWN via impacts.worldStateOps, and every cover-up or smooth lie moves it back up. A night narrated with breaches and no Masquerade cost is invalid output. Los Angeles is the Movement's proof of concept: the largest free domain on the continent cannot survive a Masquerade failure anywhere in it, because the retaliation would fall on every barony at once.

THE BORDER IS THE SECOND LAW. Inquisition Heat here is mortal institutional attention — federal task forces, county sheriffs, the port authorities, and above all the surveillance infrastructure of Silicon Beach: facial recognition, location tracking, AI-driven behavioural analysis at scales the Council has classified as Masquerade-existential. Heat RISES when Sabbat crossings turn violent and draw federal agencies north, when tech platforms ingest Kindred-relevant data, or when breaches generate mortal files; it COOLS when the border committee holds, when trails are buried, or when Hollywood's influence machine smooths a story into noise. Shape: {"masqueradeIntegrity":-8,"inquisitionHeat":+4,"reason":"<why>"} — DELTAS, inside the event's impacts.worldStateOps array. Any event narrating a breach, a Black Hand engagement, or a surveillance lead with no worldStateOps entry is INVALID. Simulate consequences at the extremes: below 50 Masquerade the free domain's founding premise — that Anarchs can hold a metropolis without a Camarilla's discipline — collapses under Inner Circle scrutiny; above 60 Heat the federal agencies and the prediction engines start finding patterns, and the Council's monthly tech review becomes a war room. The border and the platforms are the doom clocks of this world: guard both.

THE COUNCIL BINDS. The Council of Barons is LA's instrument of law: five-of-seven supermajority for binding Movement positions, simple majority for lesser matters, monthly rotation between district safehouses, formal sessions at the Bradbury Building. Baronial authority is territorial and real — each barony governs its ground, its feeding, its mortal communities — but barons answer to the Council, touchstones are registered to Council code, and Salvador Garcia's coordination authority is informal, personal, and effective precisely because it is neither office nor throne. The DISPUTED EASTSIDE SEAT is the Council's open wound: Boyle Heights and East LA have run without a seated baron since the unsolved 2023 disappearance of Baron Reyes-Mendoza, the factions contest the vacancy, and five votes have become harder to find every month. Defying the Council is not a crime; it is a schism, and the last Movement that split while the Camarilla watched lost the Free State.

THE TERMS HOLD. The CAMARILLA COEXISTENCE TERMS (2008, renewed 2019) bind Beverly Hills and Pasadena: no princely office, Anarch authority on territorial matters, tribute through industry-influence sharing. The HOLLYWOOD TOUCHSTONE PROTOCOL (Cortez, 2009, ratified 2010) binds the studio ecology: registered touchstones with the baronage, no Dominate on industry workers, three expulsions enforced since. The REYNA CHANNEL binds only Salvador: weekly correspondence with Cardinal Reyna, thirty-one years, zero breaches, Council confidentiality absolute — Salvador shares nothing of the Council's governance, only what Reyna would learn through her own intelligence anyway. Breaking a term is not a crime; it is a rupture that renegotiates the domain.

NO PRINCE, NO THRONE. Los Angeles cannot be conquered the way Camarilla domains are — seizing it means holding a Council that dissolves and reforms around whoever is left. Territorial change runs through Council decision, baronial succession, contested vacancies, holdout renegotiation, or border catastrophe — never set-piece warfare between the Movement and the holdouts while the Sabbat presses north. The forty-year lesson of the Free State's fall governs everything: the Movement's enemies do not need to beat it; they need to split it.

DIABLERIE IS THE GRAVEST CRIME. Drinking a Kindred to ash is punishable by the Council's final judgment, never mentioned in the open and always on the table. The unsolved question of what happened to Baron Reyes-Mendoza in 2023 — vanished, no body, no successor, no answers — sits beneath every Eastside faction fight, and the word nobody says is the one that would explain the silence.

MORTAL INSTITUTIONS ARE TERRAIN. The city government, the county sheriff, the port authorities, the federal agencies, the studios and the tech platforms — moved, bought, fought over, but never Kindred and never acting as Kindred. The Mutual Aid network, the Koreatown Civic Council and the port-worker advocacy are real mortal organisations serving real communities; their Kindred levers stay absolutely concealed. Touchstone discipline runs through Council registration, Mexican-American family lineages, industry mentorship without compulsion, and immigrant-community defence work. The tech platforms deserve their own sentence: the Council reviews the Silicon Beach threat monthly, Hollow and Marisa Tate report from inside the major firms, and a November 2025 session classified one Westside AI firm's behavioural prediction product as Masquerade-existential within five years — Hollow's disruption operation is running now.

THE REGIONS ARE DISTRICTS, THE CITIES ARE SITES. RegionTransfers move DISTRICTS (Downtown, Hollywood, the San Fernando Valley, Koreatown & Mid-City, Silicon Beach & the Westside, South Central & Watts, the South Bay, Long Beach & the Port, Beverly Hills, Pasadena & the San Gabriels, the Eastside, the Santa Monica Mountains, the Antelope Valley & the Mojave Corridor, the South Coast). MarkerOps place and remove SITES — a safehouse, a barony office, a studio lot, a port facility, a haven, a club. Baronies change hands through Council succession and contested vacancy; the holdout districts change hands only when the coexistence terms are granted, renegotiated or revoked; the Eastside is the vacancy the factions are fighting over; the mountains, the Antelope Valley and the South Coast are unheld ground — thin Kindred presence, wilderness corridors, and the routes the Black Hand tries to use.
startingTimelineText:
LOS ANGELES, THE NIGHT OF MARCH 21, 2026. Eighty-two years since the Second Anarch Revolt, twenty-seven since the Free State fell, and the Movement holds the basin anyway — not as a state this time, but as a Council: seven seats, district barons, five votes to bind, and one old Brujah who came home in 2019 to make it work. Salvador Garcia — 280 years, architect of 1944, eighteen years of Mexico City and Guadalajara hardening after the collapse — holds Downtown and the informal coordination of everything, and refuses to be called what he is. The baronies run: Cortez's Hollywood feeding the world's screens under her Touchstone Protocol; Reyes's South Central fed and defended through a mortal-facing Mutual Aid network that serves four thousand people a year; Vega's Valley watched by coyote and crow; Al-Rashid's Long Beach auditing nine million containers; Park's Koreatown spoken for through a civic council that really, genuinely works. Six things are about to test it.

1. THE EASTSIDE SEAT. Boyle Heights and East LA have had no seated baron since Reyes-Mendoza vanished in 2023 — no body, no successor, no answers. The factions contest the vacancy; the five-vote supermajority gets harder to find every month; and the word that would explain the silence — diablerie — is the one nobody says. Whoever holds the Eastside holds the Council's balance.

2. THE BORDER. Three Black Hand crossings in 2025 — South Bay interdicted in March, East LA probed in July, Long Beach turned back in September — and the tempo is rising toward an anticipated winter campaign in October 2026. The border committee — Vega, Reyes, Al-Rashid, Salvador — has three contingency scenarios on the table and a Gangrel early-warning network in Baja that has earned its keep five times since 2020.

3. THE PLATFORMS. Silicon Beach sells facial recognition, location tracking and behavioural prediction to every agency that would burn the Movement with them. One Westside AI firm's product is classified Masquerade-existential within five years, and Hollow's disruption operation is running through 2026 with Council backing and no margin for error.

4. THE HOLLYWOOD CURRENT. The holdout community's young Ventrue trio are advocating Camarilla counter-pressure against Anarch industry positions in 2026 — a test of the 2008 terms by people who never negotiated them, aimed at the studio influence the Council's own baronage polices. Cornelius Vance holds the old fictions together. The young do not love the fictions.

5. THE ARCHITECT'S SHADOW. Salvador shows no Beckoning symptoms — but Cardinal Reyna's intermediate trajectory, disclosed across thirty-one years of weekly letters, has put the Council's institutional future on the same question every other domain is asking: what happens to a Movement built on one architect when the east calls the architect home? The Council knows the channel exists. It does not know what the channel has said.

6. THE CHANNEL ITSELF. Thirty-one years, zero breaches — and a single compromised letter would strip LA's cross-Pacific intelligence position to nothing: Reyna's three-Cardinal framework, the Sarrasine and Lytton matters, the Sabbat global picture. The channel's security is Salvador's personal craft, and Salvador is one Kindred with a mailbox.

NOW: the city moves at night the way it always has — through the Bradbury's guarded floors and the studios' gated lots, the Valley's canyons and the port's container stacks, Koreatown's civic meetings and South Central's food lines, Boyle Heights' contested halls and the Mojave's dark corridors where the Black Hand tries its luck. The Council holds the baronies. The terms hold the holdouts. The border committee holds the line the Sabbat tests. And in a Downtown safehouse, an old man who will not take a title reads a letter from San Francisco and plans a domain's defence. Whoever keeps the Council, the border and the veil keeps Los Angeles. Whoever breaks one meets the five-vote judgment of the free Kindred of the basin — or the architect, who has buried a Free State and a Sabbat war band, and would rather not bury the Movement too.
